    orig_fixed = df.loc[df['item_code']==222,'period_current'].iloc[0]
    dep_fixed = df.loc[df['item_code']==223,'period_current'].iloc[0]
    orig_intangible = df.loc[df['item_code']==228,'period_current'].iloc[0]
    dep_intangible = df.loc[df['item_code']==229,'period_current'].iloc[0]
    orig_inv = df.loc[df['item_code']==231,'period_current'].iloc[0]
    dep_inv = df.loc[df['item_code']==232,'period_current'].iloc[0]
    ratio_fixed = abs(dep_fixed)/orig_fixed

    ratio_inv = abs(dep_inv)/orig_inv

    ratios_years.append(avg_ratio)
result = sum(ratios_years)/len(ratios_years)*100
